title: Veggie and Mushroom Patty Tray Bake
subtitle: with Middle Eastern Spices
description: Dig into a bowl of colours, textures and flavours: 'meaty' mushroom patties, fresh spinach, crunchy pepitas, and roasted carrot and pumpkin tossed in Moroccan ras el hanout.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 200C. Line 2 oven trays with baking paper. Peel the pumpkin, then cut into 2cm chunks. Peel the carrot, then cut into 5mm-thick rounds. Finely grate the zest of half the lemon, then juice the half.

Roast veggies: Put the pumpkin and carrot on one lined tray, scatter with the lemon zest and 1 tsp ras el hanout, then drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil. Season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Roast for 20 mins.
Make dressing: Meanwhile, put 2 tsp lemon juice and 3 tsp olive oil in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper and whisk to combine.

Warm mushroom patties: Brush the mushroom patties with 1 tsp olive oil. Put the patties and pepitas on the remaining lined tray and roast on an upper oven rack for a further 5 mins or until the vegetables are tender, the pepitas are toasted and the patties are warmed through. Cut the patties into 2-3cm chunks. Coarsely chop the pepitas.

Serve up: Add the roasted vegetables and half the spinach to the lemon dressing and gently toss to combine, allowing the spinach to wilt slightly. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the roasted veggie salad and remaining spinach among bowls. Top with the patties, scatter with the pepitas and enjoy.
Make it yours: Add a creamy finish with a generous dollop of Greek-style or natural yoghurt.
